connector.name: Aoexl Sign
connector.registryDescription: Create signing requests, check status, send reminders, and manage Aoexl templates.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.aoexl.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package aoexl-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the aryansingh account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer your Aoexl API key from Settings → MCP API Keys.
